title: Advancing Lung Cancer Screening One Text at a Time
official: Advancing Lung Cancer Screening One Text at a Time
summary: The purpose of this study is to assess the feasibility, acceptability, and preliminary impact of text messaging to promote lung cancer screening.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* 50 to 80 years old
* have not completed their annual screening for lung cancer
* have a 20 pack-year smoking history
* currently smoke or have quit within the past 15 years
* speak English and/or Spanish
* have a functioning cellphone number with unlimited text messaging capacity
* be willing to complete a baseline and a follow-up (at Month 3) survey

Exclusion Criteria:

* being up-to-date on their annual lung cancer screening
